newsitem.title: ITALY: Sept Btp LIFFE future forges fresh record high.
newsitem.headline: Sept Btp LIFFE future forges fresh record high.

text.p: The September Btp future on LIFFE wasted no time setting the latest in a series of record highs on Wednesday, rising to 134.28 in early trade.
The future, which set a record on Tuesday of 134.22, was trading 20 basis points up at 134.20 by 0740 GMT.

On the cash market, the February 2007 Btp was also 20 basis points higher at 99.90 with a yield of 6.87 percent. The spread over the benchmark Bund was a shade wider than yesterday's 117 basis point record, standing at 119.
